idHelp: ID 由数据库根据现有数据和序列状态分配。追加生成不会重新从 1 开始，也不会重置或覆盖已有主键。
The database assigns IDs based on existing data and sequence state. Appending does not restart at 1, reset IDs or overwrite existing primary keys.
defaultHelp: 本列不提供生成值，数据库使用已定义的默认值：{value}。可切换为生成器来自定义内容。
No value is generated for this column. The database uses its default: {value}. Switch to a generator to customize the value.
nullHelp: 此列没有数据库默认值，省略后写入 NULL（空值）。需要真实内容时，请切换为生成器。
This column has no database default, so omitting it writes NULL. Switch to a generator to provide a value.
rangeError: {minimum}不能大于{maximum}，请调整这两个边界。
{minimum} must not exceed {maximum}. Adjust the two bounds.
timeError: 时间格式应为 HH:MM 或 HH:MM:SS。
Time must use HH:MM or HH:MM:SS.
weekdaysEmpty: 自定义星期至少选择一天。
Select at least one custom weekday.
charsetEmpty: 请至少填写一个允许出现的字符。
Enter at least one allowed character.
charsetPlaceholder: 例如 ABCDEF0123456789 或 甲乙丙丁
charsetDefault: 默认：字母、数字、空格、下划线、连字符
Default: letters, digits, spaces, underscores and hyphens
defaultPlaceholder: 留空使用生成器默认值
Leave blank for the generator default
compatibilityHint: 按字段类型推荐；完整兼容性与约束由检查配置验证。
Recommended by field type. Check the configuration to verify full compatibility and constraints.
unavailableGenerator: 生成器 {generator} 不在当前可用列表中。
formatExample: 格式示例：{example}。实际样例由当前引擎和规则生成。
Format example: {example}. Actual samples use the current engine and rules.
legacyYearsHint: 仅在对应日期留空时生效；已导入的年份配置会保留。
Applies only when the corresponding date is blank. Imported year settings are preserved.
noParams: 此生成器没有可配置参数。
This generator has no configurable parameters.
sourceRequired: 派生列需要至少一个来源字段。
A derived column requires at least one source field.
sourceSelf: A derived column cannot reference itself.
sourceHint: 多个字段以英文逗号分隔。
expressionHint: 表达式可用 value 或 row["字段名"]；完整语法由检查配置验证。
Expressions can use value or row["field_name"]. Check the configuration to validate the full syntax.
compositeReference: 复合外键 ({columns}) 作为同一组引用，由数据库关系规则共同处理。
Composite foreign key ({columns}) is handled as one group by the database relationship rules.
selfReference: 此列引用本表。空表预览可能全部为 NULL；空表正式写入会先留空，再回填部分引用，不能保证这里的 NULL 比例。100% NULL 会保持全部留空。

This column references its own table. Previewing an empty table may show only NULLs. Filling an empty table first leaves NULLs, then fills some references, so this NULL percentage is not guaranteed. Explicit 100% NULL keeps all values NULL.
compositeSelfReference: 复合自引用必须使用整组有效引用键；本表没有可用引用键时，当前工作台不支持初始化，调整 NULL 百分比也不能解除这一限制。

A composite self-reference requires a complete, valid key group. The workbench cannot initialize it when this table has no usable reference keys. Changing the NULL percentage does not remove that limitation.
nullProbabilityHelp: 按每条记录的概率抽样，不是固定数量；少量预览可能没有 NULL。应用修改后重新预览，才能看到新规则的效果。
This is a per-record probability, not a fixed count. A small preview may contain no NULLs. Apply your changes and preview again to see the new rule.
nullRange: NULL 百分比必须在 0 到 100 之间。
NULL percentage must be between 0 and 100.
uniqueLocked: 数据库单列唯一约束已锁定。
Locked by the database’s single-column uniqueness constraint.
uniqueComposite: 复合主键或复合唯一约束不表示本列单独唯一。
A composite primary key or unique constraint does not make this column individually unique.
advanced: 高级配置（通常无需调整）
advancedHint: 普通生成规则继承全局数据生成引擎与语言。这里保留原生方法、额外约束和导入的高级参数；请在应用后检查配置。
Standard rules inherit the global engine and data language. Native methods, additional constraints and imported advanced parameters are preserved here. Check the configuration after applying changes.
objectPlaceholder: JSON 对象；留空使用默认值
JSON object; leave blank for defaults
providerPlaceholder: 留空继承全局，或填写与全局相同的引擎
Leave blank to inherit, or enter the global engine
providerHint: 当前仅支持继承全局或填写与全局相同的引擎；其他值会保留，但检查会阻止生成。
Currently supports inheriting or matching the global engine. Other values are preserved, but checks will block generation.
nativeHint: 原生方法会优先于普通生成器执行，请按对应引擎的方法签名填写。
Native methods take priority over standard generators. Follow the method signature for the selected engine.
computedReadonly: 数据库计算列，由数据库自动计算，规则只读。
Database-computed column. The database calculates its value; the rule is read-only.
idReadonly: 数据库自增主键，规则只读。
Database auto-increment primary key; the rule is read-only.
startDateHint: 格式 YYYY-MM-DD；显示当前生效边界。留空沿用年份范围。
YYYY-MM-DD; shows the effective bound. Leave blank to use the year range.
endDateHint: 格式 YYYY-MM-DD；包含结束日期。
startTimeHint: 格式 HH:MM:SS；取消“一整天”后生效。
HH:MM:SS; applies when All day is unchecked.
endTimeHint: 格式 HH:MM:SS；包含结束时间。
allDayHint: 勾选后可生成 00:00:00–23:59:59 内的时间；取消勾选可指定开始和结束时间。
When checked, generate times from 00:00:00 through 23:59:59. Uncheck to specify start and end times.
weekdaysHint: 按星期限制日期；工作日指周一至周五，不排除法定节假日。
Restrict dates by weekday. Weekdays means Monday–Friday, including public holidays.
charsetHint: 候选字符决定结果中允许出现的字符，不是 UTF-8 等编码名称。
Allowed characters determine which characters may appear in the result; this is not an encoding name such as UTF-8.
choicesHint: 填写 JSON 数组，例如 ["pending", "paid", "shipped"]；数值可写 [1, 2, 3]。
Enter a JSON array, such as ["pending", "paid", "shipped"] or [1, 2, 3] for numbers.
weightsHint: 填写值和权重组成的 JSON 对象，例如 {"普通": 80, "VIP": 20}。
Enter a JSON object mapping values to weights, such as {"Standard": 80, "VIP": 20}.
templateHint: 例如 SKU-{sequence:04d}；sequence 表示序号，04d 表示补齐 4 位。
For example, SKU-{sequence:04d}; sequence is the sequence number, and 04d pads it to four digits.
sequenceHint: 本次生成从此序号开始；不会读取或重置数据库 ID。
This generation starts at this sequence number. Database IDs are not read or reset.
patternHint: 例如 [A-Z]{3}[0-9]{4}；按此正则生成匹配的字符串。
For example, [A-Z]{3}[0-9]{4}; generate strings matching this pattern.
maskHint: For example, 1##########; each # is replaced with a random digit.
schemaHint: A JSON Schema object, such as {"type":"object","properties":{"active":{"type":"boolean"}}}.
optionalHint: 可选；留空由生成器决定。
Optional; leave blank for the generator to decide.
defaultHint: Leave blank to use the default: {value}.
